reviews.title: Can’t believe Apple allows not tested apps to their store.
reviews.text:
Companion for Bose SoundRouch is very poor quality it’s unstable. The UI experience is non-intuitive actually horrible, the search for stations feature keeps crashing and is in a constant loop.

If you want to send feedback to customer support as the button suggests that email will not be sent out from that application because there is a bug, the Spotify could be added to this account, but you must be a freaking developer to enable endpoints on the application and I know a little bit about it and I could not complete a task. The steps in the screen do not provide expected task completion. 

How does Apple
Release Control allow such poor quality apps on their store? Mind you this is not a free up, we customers pay for it.

reviews.title: Garbage.
reviews.text: The app found my device and my stations on preset. But all I got was garbage for sound. The only clear station sounded like it was on 2x speed.

reviews.title: Purchase with Caution
reviews.text:
Christian (App Developer) was very helpful when it came to assisting with connecting the App to my Bose SoundTouch.  However, the App has turned out to be unusable with the quality of streaming for the mainstream UK radio channels being very poor with either intermittent sound, distortion or buffering followed by double speed. Furthermore it is not possible to stream BBC Stations.

The main reason for purchasing the App was to return web based radio and preset button functionality and stream BBC stations as well as commercial radio. Unfortunately, I cannot do this and have deleted the App !
I did ask for a refund but didn’t get a response.

reviews.title: Bricked my speaker
reviews.text:
This app bricked my speaker (SoundTouch 20 series 1) my radio disconnected after Bose switched off the sound touch cloud functionality, so turned to the web for solutions. This app reportedly could help. Installed and very clunky to set up but I got two presets working again but the audio was all choppy, stuttery and broken. So I rebooted the speakers, ans then it was bricked. :( had my speaker working great for the last 12 years. Then this week Bose dropped the radio functionality from it, and this app totally bricked it, so now I can’t even AirPlay or Aux into it any more. 
Really disappointed.

reviews.title: Alternative App
reviews.text: I paid for and downloaded the app, set it up with some difficulty. The presets on my Bose 20 did not work the same as before. The sound was distorted and buffered. Cannot operate the Bose presets without running the program on my iPhone being active! Tried to contact the seller but the web is in German. Still investigating and not sure if I can get my money back.

reviews.title: Annoying clicking noise
reviews.text: When playing radio it had an annoying clicking noise every 10 seconds.

reviews.title: Don’t waste your money !
reviews.text: Without a doubt this doesn’t work as advertised! I know Bose is terminating their app in February 2026 but this isn’t the answer . Not user friendly and you loose support for the add on subscriptions you had in the past . The are advertising that will work like the Bose app and will work after the Bose app shuts down . There must me a better solution and this is definitely not it ! Like I said don’t waste your $2.99!!
